posts.title: CULTURE CANCER
posts.description: This is an in-depth article about why groups of people hate other groups of people, and why culture can become cancerous. From Israel and Gaza, to Nazis and racism, we dissect this complex topic in a very simple to understand way.

posts.title: TROM Articles
posts.description: This is it people! We are releasing a new TROM Project for the first time since 2020 or something. There is a lot to explore and know about, so our Articles will be a way to explain the complicated world we are facing, in simple and "fun" ways.
